description: This file serves as the main entry point for a React-based web application. It imports necessary dependencies like React, ReactDOM, styles, and the main App component. It initializes the React application by rendering the App component inside a DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for the React application in the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the created root using React's StrictMode wrapper.
